description_en: Retrieves the verification content for an accelerated domain name. The returned content depends on whether the global resource plan is enabled for the domain
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainVerifyData，根据加速域名是否开启全球资源计划，返回对应的校验内容
kebab_example: aliyun cdn describe-domain-verify-data --domain-name www.yourdomain.com --global-resource-plan off --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainVerifyData

parameters.description_en: The accelerated domain name. You can query only one domain name at a time.
parameters.description_zh: 加速域名，仅支持查询单个域名。
parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. You can query only one domain name at a time

- **off** (disabled)
